SELECT t.tdm52_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , t.tdm52_title AS title , t.tdm52_check_item AS check_item , t.tdm52_checker_id AS checker_id , t.tdm52_checker_nm AS checker_name , t.tdm52_check_result_nm AS check_result_name , t.tdm52_check_status_cd AS check_status_code , t.tdm52_check_status_nm AS check_status_name FROM ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl.* , CASE WHEN tdm52_checker_id IS NULL THEN '(미지정)' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(tdm52_checker_id) END AS tdm52_checker_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckResult', tdm52_check_result_cd, tdm52_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm52_check_result_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckStatus', tdm52_check_status_cd, tdm52_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm52_check_status_nm , '['|| tdm43_role_nm || '-' || CASE WHEN tdm10_common_yn = 'true' THEN '공통'
ELSE '개별' END ||'] ' ||tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS tdm52_title , CONCAT('('||tdm43_manl_cd||') ', tdm43_check_item) AS tdm52_check_item , tdm43_role_nm AS tdm52_role_nm , tdm43_task_nm AS tdm52_task_nm , tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm AS task_detail_nm , tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS task_duty_nm , tdm43_manl_cd AS manl_cd FROM tdm52_chck_manl INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_id = tdm52_manl_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm43_task_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ) t WHERE CONCAT(task_duty_nm, tdm52_check_item, tdm52_checker_nm) ILIKE #{searchText}
AND tdm52_checker_id IS NULL
ORDER BY tdm52_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm52_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , task_detail_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , task_duty_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , manl_cd
mapper.sql: t.tdm52_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , t.tdm52_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , t.tdm52_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , t.tdm52_company_id AS company_id , t.tdm52_manl_id AS manl_id , t.tdm43_manl_org_id AS manl_org_id , t.tdm52_role_id AS role_id , t.tdm52_org_id AS org_id , t.tdm52_check_ym AS check_ym , t.tdm52_role_nm AS role_name , t.tdm52_common_type_nm AS common_type_name , t.tdm52_task_nm AS task_name , t.tdm52_check_item AS check_item , t.tdm52_check_cycle_info AS check_cycle_info , t.tdm52_check_how AS check_how , t.tdm52_check_evid_doc_nm AS check_evid_doc_name , t.tdm52_ref_basis AS ref_basis , t.tdm52_checker_id AS checker_id , t.tdm52_checker_nm AS checker_name , TO_CHAR(t.tdm52_check_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS check_date , t.tdm52_check_result_cd AS check_result_code , t.tdm52_check_result_nm AS check_result_name , t.tdm52_check_cmnt AS check_cmnt , t.tdm52_check_status_cd AS check_status_code , t.tdm52_check_status_nm AS check_status_name , t.tdm52_file_count_str AS file_count_str
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl.* , tdm43_manl_org_id , tdm43_role_id AS tdm52_role_id , tdm43_role_nm AS tdm52_role_nm , tdm43_org_id AS tdm52_org_id , tdm43_task_nm AS tdm52_task_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm52_checker_id) AS tdm52_checker_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckResult', tdm52_check_result_cd, tdm52_company_id, tdm52_check_date) AS tdm52_check_result_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckStatus', tdm52_check_status_cd, tdm52_company_id, tdm52_check_date) AS tdm52_check_status_nm , tdm51_check_ym AS tdm52_check_ym , tdm51_chck_job_id AS tdm52_chck_job_id , CONCAT('('||tdm43_manl_cd||') ', tdm43_check_item) AS tdm52_check_item , f_get_tdmCheckCycle(tdm43_manl_id) AS tdm52_check_cycle_info , tdm43_check_evid_doc_nm AS tdm52_check_evid_doc_nm , tdm43_check_how AS tdm52_check_how , tdm43_ref_basis AS tdm52_ref_basis , CASE WHEN tdm10_common_yn = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE '지정' END AS tdm52_common_type_nm , f_get_tdmEvidCount(tdm52_chck_manl_id) ||'건' AS tdm52_file_count_str FROM tdm52_chck_manl INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_id = tdm52_manl_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm43_task_id WHERE tdm52_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId} ) t
mapper.update: UPDATE tdm52_chck_manl SET tdm52_check_date = CAST(#{checkDate} AS date) , tdm52_check_result_cd = CAST(#{checkResultCode} AS varchar) , tdm52_check_cmnt = CAST(#{checkCmnt} AS text) , tdm52_check_status_cd = CAST(#{checkStatusCode} AS varchar) , tdm52_upd_nm = #{updName} , tdm52_upd_date = f_sysdate() WHERE tdm52_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId}
mapper.select: SELECT tdm59_appr_status_cd FROM tdm52_chck_manl INNER JOIN tdm60_chck_manl_appr ON ( tdm60_chck_manl_id = tdm52_chck_manl_id AND tdm60_appr_seq = ( SELECT MIN(tdm60_appr_seq) FROM tdm60_chck_manl_appr WHERE tdm60_chck_manl_id = tdm52_chck_manl_id ) ) INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt.* FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt ON tdm59_chck_exct_id = tdm53_chck_exct_id WHERE tdm53_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm53_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym AND tdm53_role_id = tdm51_role_id AND tdm59_appr_emp_id = tdm60_appr_emp_id ) tdm59 ON TRUE WHERE tdm52_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId} ORDER BY tdm59_cmnt_type DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tdm61_chck_insuff_appr WHERE tdm61_chck_insuff_id = ( SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff_id FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId} )
mapper.select: SELECT sys10_file_id FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY LPAD(COALESCE(sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT cmnt_min_limit , evid_file_check_yn FROM ( SELECT tdm91_start_date AS start_date , CAST(tdm91_cmnt_min_limit AS int) AS cmnt_min_limit , CASE WHEN tdm91_evid_file_check_yn = 'true' THEN true ELSE false END AS evid_file_check_yn FROM tdm91_company_setup WHERE tdm91_company_id = #{companyId} UNION ALL SELECT CAST('2026-01-01' AS date), CAST(null AS int), true ) t WHERE start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1
